name: Kouyoku Senki ExS-Tia R Kurenai no Joou
original_name: 光翼戦姫エクスティアR 紅の女王
source:
After peace returns to the modern world, Leese goes back to her otherworldly home to aid in reconstruction efforts. Though her country welcomes her return, Logia's demonic invasion has dealt a devastating toll to its citizens.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3508180/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
现代世界恢复和平后，莉丝回到她超凡脱俗的家园，帮助重建工作。尽管她的国家欢迎她的回归，但洛吉亚的恶魔入侵却给其公民带来了毁灭性的损失。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3508180/]Steam[/url]]
